channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Ed Sheeran tour controversy: Finneas, Aaron Rowe quit after Macklemore is removed over Free Palestine remarks
item.description: Ed Sheeran’s The Loop Tour faces growing controversy after Macklemore was removed from its US dates following pro-Palestine remarks. Finneas, Aaron Rowe, and other support acts have since withdrawn, citing concerns over artistic expression.

item.title: Taylor Swift makes first public appearance since wedding in red gingham dress at Travis Kelce’s Chiefs game
item.description: Taylor Swift made her first public appearance since marrying Travis Kelce at the Chiefs’ game against the Broncos, wearing a red gingham dress from Gigi Hadid’s Guest in Residence and showing off her wedding band.

item.title: Iran war costs US military $38 billion as CBO warns of billions more in monthly expenses
item.description: The CBO said the estimate largely reflects the cost of replacing munitions expended during the conflict and equipment lost in battle, along with higher fuel costs for the US military and other expenses.

item.title: Pete Hegseth faces impeachment push from Republican lawmaker over military action against Iran without congressional app
item.description: The move could force a vote in the US House of Representatives, potentially putting pressure on fellow Republicans as they prepare to return home ahead of the November midterm elections.

item.title: New Measles Deaths Send US Fatality Total to Highest in Decades
item.description: Pennsylvania health officials confirmed two additional measles-associated deaths, bringing the total confirmed deaths in the state this year to four, and driving US fatalities to the highest level in decades.

item.title: Starbucks Peanuts collection: Snoopy-themed cups, plush toys and accessories launch for fall 2026
item.description: Starbucks has launched its limited-edition Peanuts collection, bringing Snoopy and the gang to drinkware, accessories and plush toys. The fall range is inspired by The Great Pumpkin and is available at select coffeehouses while stocks last.

item.title: Kash Patel senate grilling: From Epstein files, Trump investigations to FBI hiring rules — Key flashpoints
item.description: The latest hearing again underscored the deep partisan divide over Patel’s leadership of the FBI, with Republicans highlighting crime reductions and Democrats focusing on allegations of politicisation, transparency and Patel’s conduct.

item.title: What ₹17 crore gets you in Poland vs Mumbai? Indian man’s home comparison video goes viral
item.description: In the video, Deepanshu Lakhwan takes viewers around the property and explains how much more space the estimated amount could provide compared with Mumbai's housing market.

item.title: Nick Reiner will not face death penalty in alleged murders of parents Rob and Michele Singer Reiner
item.description: Prosecutors will not seek the death penalty against Nick Reiner, who is accused of killing his parents, filmmaker Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner. If he is convicted, he could face life imprisonment without parole.&nbsp;

item.title: Agartala-Delhi IndiGo flight carrying 103 passengers diverted to Lucknow after smoke warning
item.description: IndiGo flight 6E6504 landed safely at Lucknow Airport at 6:29 pm, carrying 103 passengers and six crew members, airport authorities said.

item.title: Trump’s bid to put his name on Kennedy Center blocked again by federal judge; ‘Trump Plaza’ plan also halted
item.description: US District Judge ordered the center to temporarily halt its latest proposal to put Trump’s name on the memorial to former President John F. Kennedy. Cooper also barred the center’s board from moving ahead with plans to rename the campus the “President Donald J. Trump Plaza.”

item.title: UPI sets charges for merchant payments above ₹2,000, caps fee at ₹300
item.description: The new MDR framework and threshold structure will come into effect from 15 October, giving acquiring banks, payment aggregators, fintech applications and corporate accounting platforms time to update their software engines and billing systems.

item.title: ‘Strong dollar is not a price on a screen’: Bessent defends US currency as global transactions rise
item.description: Bessent said during testimony before the House Financial Services Committee that the Trump administration’s efforts to provide regulatory, tax, trade and energy certainty were attracting trillions of dollars into the United States.

item.title: Trump’s 4-year US student visa rule blocked: What it means for Indian students
item.description: DHS had argued that the fixed-term system would help combat fraud and make it easier for the government to identify and address visa overstays.

item.title: Clarity Act could overhaul US crypto, stablecoin rules: What the bill changes and why it matters | Explained
item.description: US Senate to vote on advancing the Clarity Act, a landmark crypto bill that could reshape digital-asset rules, stablecoins and crypto regulation.

item.title: Noida schools to remain closed on September 16? Officials respond to CJP Saurav Das's claim
item.description: During his inspection of schools in Noida, part of the CJP's ongoing school audit campaign across several parts of the country, Das urged young people to conduct similar audits of government schools in their own areas.

item.title: ‘Horrible, highly political’ ruling: Trump attacks Supreme Court after mail-in voting setback
item.description: Trump's March executive order sought to restrict mail-in voting by requiring voter lists to be compiled and directing the US Postal Service to deliver ballots only to voters appearing on those lists.

item.title: India’s unemployment rate holds at 5% in August as rural joblessness eases
item.description: Urban unemployment rose to 6.8%, but a sharper fall in rural joblessness kept the overall rate unchanged; labour-force participation also edged higher

item.title: How much will Major Rishabh Singh Sambyal earn on Instagram? Ex-ADC to President Murmu launches subscriber-only content
item.description: Retired Major Rishabh Singh Sambyal's Instagram subscriptions have ignited debate online. He offers exclusive content for ₹199 (iPhone) and ₹180 (Android) monthly.

item.title: China, Russia warn against ‘weaponisation’ of space after US confirms orbital weapons
item.description: China and Russia's warning came after the US Space Force confirmed that Washington has “on-orbit space control weapons” capable of defending US forces against hostile actions by adversaries.

item.title: US admits to having weapons in orbit: How do they work, and should Russia, China worry?
item.description: Both Russia and China - the two main geopolitical rivals of the United States - pose potential threats to US interests in space.

item.title: Madras HC acquits death row convict in child abuse case: How victims' 'parrot-like' statements saved man from gallows
item.description: The high court said the prosecution case was marked by material contradictions, omissions and other deficiencies, creating reasonable doubt.

item.title: Qatar warns of ‘catastrophic’ Bab al-Mandeb closure: What it means for oil, shipping and global trade
item.description: Qatar has warned of a ‘catastrophic’ Bab al-Mandeb closure. Here’s why the key Red Sea chokepoint matters for oil, shipping and global trade.

item.title: Imran Khan ‘helped improve lives of Pakistanis’: Australian cricket greats now fear former Pakistan PM will die in jail
item.description: Cricket legends have united to express concerns over Imran Khan's health in detention. Seven former Australian captains urged their government to address Khan's treatment, advocating for independent medical assessments and humane treatment.

item.title: India to get widespread rainfall in the coming week
item.description: In the north-west, fairly widespread to widespread rainfall, accompanied by thunderstorms and lightning, is likely over Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi and Punjab on 16-17 September.

item.title: ‘Quietly opened the door to UPI fees’: Rahul Gandhi slams Modi govt over UPI transaction charges
item.description: Rahul Gandhi accused the Modi government of opening the door to UPI transaction fees, alleging US pressure behind the move. The Centre's notification bars charges on UPI/RuPay payments up to ₹2,000, while citing cybersecurity and infrastructure costs as reasons for the broader MDR framework.

item.title: Is US running short of weapons amid Iran war? Pentagon report flags missile shortfalls, supply bottlenecks
item.description: A Pentagon report reveals significant inventory shortfalls due to intensive munitions use in the West Asia conflict, resulting in strain on advanced missile stocks and a financial toll of $33.4 billion, including significant damage to military and diplomatic infrastructure.

item.title: Over 200 SpiceJet passengers protest at Delhi airport after Dubai flight gets delayed for more than 24 hours
item.description: Around 200 SpiceJet passengers protested at Delhi airport after flights to Dubai were repeatedly rescheduled and delayed since Monday. The airline attributed the disruption to operational issues following an aircraft grounding and said alternate flights were being arranged.

item.title: Vijay’s London investment trip: AIADMK jabs, ‘Why travel to UK for MoU with Noida-based company?’
item.description: CM Vijay’s high-profile UK itinerary, which included a visit to the Silverstone motor racing circuit in England where he met actor and racer Ajit Kumar, drew sharp criticism from opposition parties, which questioned whether the trip was primarily aimed at securing investments for the state.

item.title: Bengaluru CEO fixes broken footpath for ₹2,700 after lack of action from BBMP; sparks debate on ‘DIY governance’
item.description: A Bengaluru CEO’s post quickly struck a nerve on social media, sparking a fierce debate among taxpayers over the normalisation of “DIY governance” and the persistent breakdown of civic accountability.

item.title: In a first, US Air Force Secretary reveals Washington has weapons in space; to counter challenges from adversaries
item.description: US Air Force Secretary Troy Meink on Monday (local time) revealed that Washington has deployed weapons in space and plans to use them as and when needed as it faces growing space-based threats from China and Russia

item.title: Masood Azhar's bounty hike: Is Pakistan's FATF move merely symbolic? Expert weighs in
item.description: Pakistan named Masood Azhar in its 2026 most-wanted list and raised his bounty to PKR 70 lakh, days ahead of October's FATF plenary. Experts call it a familiar compliance signal, noting India will judge Pakistan on verifiable action, not announcements, ahead of a possible grey-list review.

item.title: Gurugram road rage case: Accused Kalyan Bainsla arrested, police add attempt-to-murder charge
item.description: Kalyan Bainsla, accused of hitting a woman biker in a Gurugram road rage incident, has been arrested, with police adding an attempt-to-murder charge. Bainsla denied deliberately hitting her, while his lawyer called it a case of negligence.

item.title: Indian-origin woman, friend killed after NYC subway train hits them on tracks, video of incident surfaces
item.description: Malaika Chitre and her friend Navam Kaul, both 24, died after being struck by a subway train at a Lower Manhattan station. Police are investigating why the two were on the tracks in the early hours of the morning.

item.title: ‘I am safe now’: Keralite vlogger, who claimed arrest by Mujahideen, says she escaped arrest threat in Afghanistan
item.description: “According to the law of this country, a woman cannot travel alone,” ‘Backpacker Arunima’ said
